large-title.purpose: List name at the top of the main view; collapses to a 17px semibold nav title on scroll.

title.purpose: Sheet headings, book title in the book sheet, empty-state heading.

headline.purpose: Result row titles, button labels, collapsed nav title.

body.purpose: Base size; search input, menu items, author in the book sheet.

subhead.purpose: Book count, row authors, helper messages.

cover-title.purpose: Title on generated cloth covers; 13px in the book sheet, with an 11px author at the foot.

mark.purpose: Queue numbers and ratings inside cover ribbons and badges.

shadows.name: segment-thumb
shadows.purpose: Selected segment of a segmented control.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Scrolled nav bar, row separators, scan footer.

shadows.name: glass
shadows.purpose: Material for chrome floating over covers; opaque group colour under prefers-reduced-transparency.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Cover (.96 + brightness .9), primary (.97), Add button (.92) press feedback.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Tab and segment colour changes, nav bar hairline and mini title fade, cover image fade-in.

motion.name: sheet-drag
motion.purpose: Sheet snaps back or dismisses after drag.

motion.name: cover-lift
motion.purpose: Tapped cover lifts into the book sheet; root cross-fade .22s.

motion.name: star-pop
motion.purpose: Stars pop from .55 scale when rated.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Grid becomes auto-fill columns of min 150px; sheet max width 600px, dock max 560px.

components.name: Primary Capsule Button
components.description: Evergreen capsule for the one main action in a context: Add a Book, Scan Barcode.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--on-tint, #fff); background: var(--tint, #177a63); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s ease-out, opacity .15s; } .ds-pill .ds-ic { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(.97); opacity: .9; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tint, #177a63); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Floating Tab Bar with Add
components.description: Glass capsule of four list tabs with a separate round Add button under the thumb.
components.css: .ds-dock { display: flex; gap: 10px; max-width: 560px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ic { fill: currentColor; } .ds-tabs { flex: 1; display: flex; height: 64px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--glass, rgba(255,255,255,.72)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px var(--lift, rgba(20,30,25,.16)), inset 0 0 0 .5px var(--rim, rgba(0,0,0,.08)); } .ds-tabs button { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: var(--label, #111113); font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-tabs button .ds-ic { width: 25px; height: 25px; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true] { color: var(--tint, #177a63); background: var(--fill, rgba(118,118,128,.12)); } .ds-tabs button:active { background: var(--fill-strong, rgba(118,118,128,.2)); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible, .ds-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tint, #177a63); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-add { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 64px; height: 64px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--on-tint, #fff); background: var(--tint, #177a63); box-shadow: 0 10px 26px var(--lift, rgba(20,30,25,.16)), inset 0 0 0 .5px var(--rim, rgba(0,0,0,.08)); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s ease-out; } .ds-add .ds-ic { width: 28px; height: 28px; } .ds-add:active { transform: scale(.92); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Filled iOS search well for filtering her books or searching Open Library.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 38px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--fill, rgba(118,118,128,.12)); color: var(--label2, #636366); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search .ds-ic { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; flex: none; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: none; color: var(--label, #111113); font-family: inherit; font-size: 17px; caret-color: var(--tint, #177a63); -webkit-appearance: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--label2, #636366); } .ds-search:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--tint, #177a63) 55%, transparent); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Sets a book's list in one tap; also picks the destination list when adding.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--fill, rgba(118,118,128,.12)); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg button { flex: 1; min-height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--label, #111113); font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s; } .ds-seg button[aria-checked=true] { font-weight: 600; background: var(--seg-on, #fff); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.12), inset 0 0 0 .5px var(--rim, rgba(0,0,0,.08)); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tint, #177a63); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Cover Tile with State Marks
components.description: Signature 2:3 cover: cloth binding fallback, Up Next ribbon with queue number, Finished star badge.
components.html: The Left Hand of DarknessUrsula K. Le Guin5MiddlemarchGeorge Eliot3
components.css: .ds-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 120px); gap: 2px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tile { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; overflow: hidden; background: var(--fill, rgba(118,118,128,.12)); transition: transform .15s ease-out, filter .15s; } .ds-tile:active { transform: scale(.96); filter: brightness(.9); } .ds-art { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 12px; color: #fff; } .ds-art b { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-art small { margin-top: auto; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; opacity: .86; } .ds-ribbon { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 8px; width: 24px; height: 34px; padding-top: 5px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; color: #fff; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 50% 78%, 0 100%); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-badge { position: absolute; left: 6px; bottom: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; height: 22px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: rgba(0,0,0,.5); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-badge svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: currentColor; }

components.name: Bottom Sheet with Grouped Rows
components.description: Book sheet: grabber, close well, grouped star rating and destructive row on sheet grey.
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; max-width: 390px; padding: 0 16px 16px; border-radius: 22px 22px 0 0; background: var(--sheet, #f2f2f7); color: var(--label, #111113); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-grab { position: relative; height: 22px; } .ds-grab::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 7px; left: 50%; width: 36px; height: 5px; margin-left: -18px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--fill-strong, rgba(118,118,128,.2)); } .ds-close { position: absolute; top: 14px; right: 14px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--label2, #636366); background: var(--fill, rgba(118,118,128,.12)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-close svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-close:focus-visible, .ds-remove:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tint, #177a63); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sheet h2 { margin: 10px 40px 0 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-sheet p { margin: 4px 0 20px; color: var(--label2, #636366); } .ds-group { margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--group, #fff); overflow: hidden; } .ds-rate { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 0; min-height: 66px; } .ds-remove { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 50px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font: inherit; color: var(--danger, #d70015); background: var(--group, #fff); cursor: pointer; } .ds-remove:active { background: var(--fill, rgba(118,118,128,.12)); }

components.name: Icon Well Button
components.description: Tint glyph in a circular fill well (More, per-result Add); becomes a solid tint check once added.
components.css: .ds-well { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: var(--tint, #177a63); cursor: pointer; } .ds-well svg { width: 30px; height: 30px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 50%; fill: currentColor; background: var(--fill, rgba(118,118,128,.12)); } .ds-well:active { opacity: .5; } .ds-well:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tint, #177a63); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-well:disabled { cursor: default; } .ds-well:disabled svg { color: var(--on-tint, #fff); background: var(--tint, #177a63); }

narrative.northStar: The Photos Library of Her Shelf
narrative.overview:
Bookshelf borrows the iPhone's own material instead of inventing a brand on top of it. Her covers fill the screen in a gapless grid the way photos fill the Photos app; everything else is iOS system chrome kept thin and out of the way: a large title that collapses into a frosted navigation bar, a floating capsule tab bar with a separate round Add button under the thumb, bottom sheets with grabbers, segmented controls and grouped inset rows. Light and dark follow the phone.

The density is photographic: the covers are the interface, and chrome carries only one colour of its own. A single deep green tint marks what can be tapped and what is selected. A book's state (queued, wished, finished) is never a hue; it is a small neutral frosted mark placed on the cover itself. When a cover has no image, it becomes a plain typographic binding in one of ten muted cloth colours, so the grid never shows a hole.

Motion is short and state-bound (150 to 300ms): the tapped cover lifts out of the grid into the book sheet through a view transition, sheets rise and drag down to dismiss, stars pop in sequence. Nothing moves at rest.
keyCharacteristics: One strict gapless cover grid (2px gutters, 2:3 covers), no cards.
iOS system face at every size, one family, hierarchy by size and weight only.
One tint for action and selection; state is a neutral mark on the cover.
Frosted glass for chrome that floats over covers; flat tonal grounds everywhere else.
Capsules for buttons and bars, nested radii for containers.

rules.name: The One Tint Rule
rules.body: Evergreen is for actions and selection only. It never colours a book's state, a list, or a heading.

rules.name: The State Is a Mark Rule
rules.body: Up Next is a bookmark ribbon with her queue number at the top right; Finished is a capsule badge with a star and the rating (or a check when unrated) at the bottom left; Wishlist is a capsule badge with a filled heart. All three use the neutral mark material, never a colour.

rules.name: The Covers Bring the Colour Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays neutral grey and white (or near-black in dark) so real cover art is the only saturated thing on screen.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Every string uses the system stack. Emphasis is weight, not a second family, italics, or uppercase.

rules.name: The Float Earns Glass Rule
rules.body: Only surfaces that hover over the covers (navigation bar when scrolled, tab bar, menu) are frosted. Sheets and groups are opaque tone.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are blurred and tinted by the lift colour, never hard or offset.

dos: Do let covers run edge to edge in the 2px-gap grid; keep chrome to the header, the floating dock and sheets.
Do use the tint (#177a63 light, #40cf9f dark) only for actions, selection, focus and stars.
Do show a book's state as a neutral frosted mark on the cover: ribbon with queue number, star badge, heart badge.
Do give every cover without an image a cloth binding picked by title hash, so the grid has no gaps.
Do define every colour role in both light and dark, and fall back to opaque group colour under reduced transparency.
Do keep motion between 150 and 300ms, tied to state change, and switch it off under reduced motion.
Do keep tap targets at 44px or more and respect the safe-area insets top and bottom.
donts: Don't put a book's state in a colour, a coloured shelf tab or a tinted cover overlay.
Don't wrap covers in cards, borders, list rows or gutters wider than 2px in the library view.
Don't introduce a second typeface, uppercase labels or letter-spaced captions.
Don't frost surfaces that don't float over the covers, or use hard, offset or untinted heavy shadows.
Don't add a second accent colour; red is reserved for destructive text.
